text: It's in your head. One sip.
note: Easy, warm, teasing, sure he is right, holding the cup out to his friend.
Flat, bored, slumped, certain, like calling a match.
Soaked, dazed, completely sincere, quietly amazed.
A beat, then cool and smug, totally unbothered, as if he planned it.
Confident, holding out his hand, the hero arriving to save the party. Say aux clearly, like 'ox'.
